title: Warm Crumbly Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A delicious and savory Spanish dish featuring chicken, oranges, and a crumbly texture, perfect for a date night, this low-fat-friendly paella is full of umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken broth, olive oil, paprika, salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large paella pan or skillet, heat the marinade over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the uncooked rice to the pan, stirring to combine with the marinade and chicken.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and stir in the orange segments and lemon juice.
Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
